mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ResourceHierarchy AS ( SELECT resource_no, resource_name, resource_parent_no, site_no, 0 AS level FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl WHERE resource_parent_no = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.resource_no, child.resource_name, child.resource_parent_no, child.site_no, parent.level + 1 AS level FROM om_cloud_optimizer_tbl AS child INNER JOIN ResourceHierarchy AS parent ON child.resource_parent_no = parent.resource_no WHERE child.resource_type = 0 ) SELECT LPAD('', level, ' ') || resource_no AS indented_resource_no, resource_no, resource_name, resource_parent_no, site_no, level, 0 AS count, 0 AS total_count, 0 AS entire_count FROM ResourceHierarchy ORDER BY level, resource_no;
